sources.title: Sample Size for Correlations - MetricGate
sources.snippet: A formal power analysis for correlation answers the question before data collection begins. This post explains the statistical theory behind sample-size planning for Pearson r, walks through the key formula, provides ready-to-use tables, and finishes with a full R simulation using pwr.r.test ().

sources.title: Parameters of cache systems based on a Zipf-like distribution
sources.snippet: The task is to create an analytical model of a cache system linking its size with other parameters by boundary conditions. A definition of a dynamic cache model is introduced. The parameters of a cache system are calculated using the Zipf's first law and Zipf-like distribution.
